title: Execution of instruction operations
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-state Turing machine with $k$ work tapes, let $\theta$ be a template, and let $\rho$ assign a natural number to each of the eleven registers. Executing the operation list associated with $\theta$ yields the bit string obtained by encoding, in order, the copy gates for the template’s source expressions evaluated at $\rho$, followed by the encoding of the fixed gates for its kind shifted by the value of the base expression at $\rho$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite-state Turing machine over Boolean symbols, with $k$ work tapes
